name: FirstCash
outlook:
What FirstCash says to expect

  • Full year 2026: effective income tax rateThe full year 2026 consolidated effective income tax rate is expected to range from 26% to 27% of income before income taxes.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: corporate costs and interestCorporate administrative expenses for the fourth quarter of 2026 are expected to remain at a run rate which is similar to the first three quarters of 2026, while interest expense for the fourth quarter of 2026 is expected to increase approximately 5% over the prior-year quarter assuming current interest rates.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 22, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
